scientific_limitations: Classifies the specified symmetrized forward/holding/uniform-inverse Markov kernel on an integer-degree circle only. No claim about physicality, arbitrary nonlinear conjugacies, two-point dynamics, or all continuous maps. Prior general operator theory may imply particular cases.
title: Sharp stationary-simplex collapse for forward/inverse circle dynamics
